description: This extension adds ReactiveUI support to generic host based dotnet core 10.0 / 11.0 WinForms applications. With this you can enhance your application with a UI, and use all the services provided by the generic host like DI, logging etc, together with this reactive MVVM framework.
releaseNotes: Compatibility with Net 10 / 11 and net47 / net471 / net472 / net48 / net481
